goal: Take one of the fossils from the deepest floor of Mt. Moon

subgoals.goal_text: Navigate to the specific area of the deepest floor (B2F) where the fossils are located. The evidence shows the fossils are behind a door at (5,7) in area MT_MOON_B2F|20,5.
Pick up either the Helix Fossil or the Dome Fossil from the ground on the deepest floor of Mt. Moon.
